implemented_route.composition: The public Ops CLI injects tools.ops_runners.ukraine_data.server_bootstrap.build_orchestrator into polisyos.data_forge.domains.ukraine.cli.main. Domain execution requires an explicit factory and refuses when it is absent; subprocess/workspace bootstrap remains Ops-owned.
implemented_route.roots: --root selects build/artifact root; --workspace-root selects the repository checkout used by Ops gates. If omitted, the Ops boundary resolves the process working directory; no domain-side package-parent guessing is used.
implemented_route.consumer_effect: Ops checks checkout/server prerequisites, runs the configured Part A C7 pytest command with cwd=workspace_root and POLISYOS_RUN_INTEGRATION=1, then writes typed gate/stage manifests through the domain orchestration path.
